title: Gaussian Fourier integral formula
statement: For $n\in\mathbb N$, let $a\in\mathbb R$, let $H:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb C$, and let $x\in\mathbb R^n$. The Fourier transform of $H$ paired with the Gaussian Fourier pairing of parameter $a$ equals its standard Gaussian integral against the character $t\mapsto\exp\!\left(i a\sum_{j=1}^n t_jx_j\right)$; explicitly, it is $\int_{\mathbb R^n}\exp\!\left(i a\sum_{j=1}^n t_jx_j\right)H(t)\,d\gamma(t)$, where $\gamma$ is the standard Gaussian measure on $\mathbb R^n$.
